items.title: Joey Morant interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: I knew the saxophone player in the band. He had a black, female trumpet player, Rae Carter from the Sweethearts of Rhythm.

ctx.x: Oh 1951, ’52, ’53. The black YMCA on Canada Street in Charleston, South Carolina, LeRoy Chisholm performed one night. And I drifted over there because I knew the saxophone player in the band. He had a black, female trumpet player, Rae Carter from the Sweethearts of Rhythm.
